observations.step: step 1 (auth section with username, claims and roles)
observations.body:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html><body>
  <section itemprop="auth" itemscope itemtype="https://pagelove.org/Authorization">
  <section itemprop="claims" itemscope itemtype="https://pagelove.org/Claims">
    <meta itemprop="email" content="alice@example.com">
    <meta itemprop="email_verified" content="true">
    <meta itemprop="sub" content="sub-alice">
  </section>
  <meta itemprop="username" content="sub-alice">
  <meta itemprop="role" content="alice@example.com">
  <meta itemprop="role" content="users">
</section>
</body></html>
